dct_description_sm: [ARCHIVED] This dataset has been archived as it is no longer able to be provided in this manner. For a more current version of this elevation dataset, please refer to https://nsgi.novascotia.ca/datalocator/elevation/ to access the current catalogue of available elevation products. The Nova Scotia Elevation Dataset, consisting of a Digital Elevation Model (DEM) derived from LiDAR data is available for select 1:2000 scale map sheet windows in Pictou County. The DEM is a bare earth rasterized elevation model with a one metre cell size. The area collected is a total of thirty four 1:2000 scale map sheet windows for a total coverage of approximately 95 square kilometres.
